The '''Judicial Quarter''' was a district in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Bas-Ton]] and his family ran a teahouse in the Judicial Quarter.
